title: Cascaded Retrieval with Cross-Modal Query Refinement for Efficient Visual Document Search
abstract: arXiv:2610.20367v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Retrieving information from visually rich documents requires matching queries against pages that contain complex evidence in tables, figures, and layout-dependent structures. Current vision-language retrievers address this but incur query-time costs that grow with corpus size and are impractical to scale. We propose SCOUT, a cascaded two-track retrieval framework that separates retrieval performance from exhaustive search. The visual track first uses a lightweight parent retriever to filter the corpus to a compact candidate pool, then applies a stronger multi-vector reranker only to those candidates. In parallel, a semantic track retrieves over hierarchical page and document summaries generated offline to provide a signal complementary to visual matching. The outputs are fused through cross-modal query refinement, which uses semantic scores to adjust the visual query representation before final ranking. We evaluate SCOUT on 4 major bench

translated_title: 面向高效视觉文档搜索的级联检索与跨模态查询精炼方法
translated_abstract: 从视觉丰富的文档中检索信息，需要将查询与包含表格、图表以及依赖布局的复杂证据的页面进行匹配。当前的视觉-语言检索器虽然能够解决这一问题，但其查询时的计算成本会随语料库规模增长而上升，难以实际扩展。我们提出了SCOUT，一个级联式双轨检索框架，将检索性能与穷举式搜索分离。在视觉轨道中，首先使用一个轻量级的父检索器将语料库过滤为一个紧凑的候选池，然后仅对这些候选应用更强的多向量重排序器。与此同时，语义轨道对离线生成的分层页面和文档摘要进行检索，提供与视觉匹配互补的信号。两路输出通过跨模态查询精炼进行融合，该机制在最终排序之前利用语义分数调整视觉查询的表示。我们在4个主要基准（原文在此处截断）上评估了SCOUT。
tldr: 提出SCOUT级联双轨检索框架，通过轻量级视觉检索器先筛选候选、再由多向量重排序器精排，并结合语义轨道检索离线生成的分层摘要，最后用跨模态查询精炼融合两路信号，实现高效且可扩展的视觉文档搜索。
en_tdlr: SCOUT is a cascaded two-track retrieval framework that combines lightweight visual filtering, reranking of a compact candidate pool, and semantic retrieval over offline hierarchical summaries, fused via cross-modal query refinement to achieve efficient and scalable visual document search.
